definitions.explanation: Writing information in a form, document, or designated space.

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}と{住所|じゅうしょ}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in your name and address.

examples.japanese: {必要|ひつよう}{事項|じこう}を{記入|きにゅう}する。
examples.english: To fill in the required information.

examples.japanese: {記入|きにゅう}{漏|も}れがないか{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To check that nothing was left blank.

notes:
{記入|きにゅう} is used when filling out forms or documents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {記入|きにゅう}する (to fill in, to enter)
- {記入|きにゅう}してください (please fill in)
- 〜を{記入|きにゅう}する (to fill in ~)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {記入|きにゅう}{欄|らん} (entry field, blank space)
- {記入|きにゅう}{例|れい} (example entry)
- {記入|きにゅう}{漏|も}れ (omission in filling out)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {記入|きにゅう}: fill in (forms)
- {入力|にゅうりょく}: input (digital/computer)
- {書|か}き{込|こ}む: write in, fill in (informal)
- {記載|きさい}: description, mention (more formal)
